Each stem thus ranges from 10 times the stem value to one less than the next stem's starting point. For example, the stem "4" ranges from 40 to 49.

In terms of the stem-and-leaf plot, "fewer than 70 fish" means tanks with counts less than 70. Specifically, this includes all entries where the stem is less than 7 and any entry where the stem is 7 but the leaf is less than 0 (which there are none in this case). Therefore, tanks with exactly 70 fish should not be included in the count since 70 is not "fewer than" 70.
